unresolved: StoreMpWebhookView inherits default throttles (anon 100/day + user 1000/day per IP); MP webhook egress IPs are shared across all DAVENT stores — whether legitimate volume can exceed the cap and whether MP retries on 429 is provider/deployment-dependent (needs_validation).

Order payment-proof images use object_url(key, private=True) with default 7-day presigned TTL (orders domain, adjacent surface) — proofs are buyer PII-ish receipts; whether 7-day bearer URLs are acceptable vs the 1h chat-attachment precedent is a policy question outside this unit's confirmed scope.

checks.invariant: Seller-controlled storage endpoint must not let the server issue signed S3 requests to arbitrary/internal hosts (SSRF).
checks.result: PASS (run1 fix confirmed). StoreStorageConfigSerializer.validate_endpoint requires https:// (http only when settings.DEBUG) and restricts hostname to _STORAGE_ENDPOINT_HOSTS suffix allowlist (r2.cloudflarestorage.com, amazonaws.com, backblazeb2.com, wasabisys.com, digitaloceanspaces.com, supabase.co, storage.googleapis.com) with correct '.'-boundary endswith check — userinfo tricks, suffix spoofs, trailing-dot and IDN variants all fail closed. _byo_backend trusts the DB row but the only write path is this serializer; boto3 client built verbatim from validated endpoint. Bucket regex, region default and credential vault encryption (enc:v1: + per-store AAD purpose) verified; DELETE clears secrets and invalidates the 300s BYO cache.

checks.invariant: Merchant MP secrets (access/refresh token, webhook secret) must be write-only: never returned by any read path, never logged, bound to the owning store.
checks.result: PASS. MpConnectSerializer fields are write_only; mp_status_payload returns only flags/mp_user_id/connected_at; StoreMpWebhookConfig has_secret flag only. Tokens sealed via encrypt_secret with purpose 'StoreMpAccount.access_token:<store_id>' (AAD binds blob to store). get_access_token() callers are only webhook service, preferences, refunds, checkout TEST- prefix check — none serialize the token. mp_client logs method/path/status only, never the Authorization header. MpConnectView validates the token against MP /users/me before persisting; disconnect clears enc fields.

checks.invariant: Webhook authenticity per store: only events signed with that store's MP webhook secret are processed; replay bounded; payment resolution scoped to the store; MP API is source of truth.
checks.result: PASS. StoreMpWebhookView: body <=16KB (413), signed data.id from query string only (body id ignored with warning), id regex [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}, HMAC-SHA256 manifest id/request-id/ts vs per-store decrypted secret with compare_digest, +/-600s freshness (s/ms tolerant), cache.add dedup keyed slug+topic+id+request-id with release-on-error, unsigned only when DEBUG AND STORE_MP_WEBHOOK_ALLOW_UNSIGNED. StoreMpWebhookQuery re-fetches GET /v1/payments/<id> with the store's own token, rejects test payments in prod (live_mode fail-closed), requires currency_id=='ARS', resolves order via find_order_by_token(store_id=store.id) + explicit store_id double-check, requires payment_method=='mp', amount==order.total else amount_mismatch event, select_for_update on MpPayment->Order with status-machine guards. Cross-store replay impossible.

checks.invariant: No OAuth state/CSRF surface on MP connect; owner config endpoints cannot be pointed at another store; mass-assignment cannot inject store/secrets fields.
checks.result: PASS. MP 'connect' is credential paste (documented MVP — no authorization_code flow, so no state param needed); all owner endpoints resolve store via request.user.profile.store / Store.user__user with no store id in path or body (serializers whitelist fields). FiscalProfile PUT is full-form with CUIT mod-11 check; OAuthConfig google_client_secret write-only vault, client_id suffix-validated; StoreShippingConfig carrier_credentials DictField write-only -> JSON+vault, consumed only by orders carriers.py against fixed ANDREANI_BASE (no SSRF); StorePaymentConfig validates method coherence. PublicOrderPayView: published+unblocked store, orders_enabled, connected MP + mp_enabled, order by tracking_token scoped to store, PENDING_PAYMENT + not expired + payment_method=='mp', select_for_update idempotent preference reuse.

checks.invariant: Store admin panel (sales summary/daily/CSV export, customer list/detail) must be read-only, store-scoped, and safe against CSV injection / ordering injection / unbounded export.
checks.result: PASS. All views use _StoreAdminMixin.my_store -> get_object_or_404(Store, user__user=request.user) + has_ecommerce gate; every queryset filters store=store. Read-only (List/Retrieve mixins only). clean_ordering whitelist, clean_payment_method/clean_status enum-validated, date range <=366 days, EXPORT_MAX_ROWS=10_000 -> 400. _csv_safe prefixes ' to cells starting with =+-@\t\r after lstrip, applied to every cell incl. attacker-controlled customer name/email; UTF-8 BOM; filename uses safe slug.

checks.invariant: Support threads/messages must be isolated per (store, customer): customer A cannot read/write store B's or another customer's threads; owner cannot read other stores' threads; order links double-validated; owner-email abuse bounded.
checks.result: PASS. Customer views: _threads_qs filters customer=request.customer, _thread_or_404 -> 404 cross-customer; store resolved via customer_visible_store -> 404; order_token via resolve_order_link -> find_order_by_token(store) + order.customer_id==customer.pk -> 400. Owner ViewSet: get_queryset filters store=my_store() -> IDOR 404; lifecycle open/closed enforced both sides. Serializers whitelist fields only. Support has NO attachments — text-only messages (2000 chars). Email-bombing fix verified present: per-customer throttles (10/h threads, 60/h messages keyed c<pk>), per-store aggregate cap SUPPORT_STORE_MSGS_PER_HOUR=120 (cache fail-open), per-thread email min interval 30min, in-app notification deduped per thread. Worst case ~120 emails/h/store bounded.

checks.invariant: Feed customer writes (comment/like/vote) must be rate-limited for the authenticated-customer principal that is the only caller allowed; public comment listing must be bounded.
checks.result: FAIL -> candidate. FeedWriteThrottle (views.py:55-58) extends ResilientAnonRateThrottle (AnonRateThrottle). DRF AnonRateThrottle.get_cache_key returns None when request.user.is_authenticated; CustomerJWTAuthentication returns the Customer as request.user and Customer.is_authenticated==True. Every feed write endpoint requires IsCustomer, so the throttle can NEVER fire — 100% dead code. Sibling StoreReviewThrottle explicitly overrides get_cache_key to bucket POSTs by customer.pk precisely because AnonRateThrottle skips authenticated users; support domain uses _CustomerScopedThrottle keyed c<pk>. Amplifier: PublicFeedCommentsView.get returns ALL non-hidden comments with no limit/pagination -> spammed comments inflate every subsequent public GET. Registration is self-service with is_active=True default and no email-verification gate for customer_access.

checks.invariant: Feed media upload must store validated content; embed URLs must stay on whitelisted hosts; owner endpoints store-scoped.
checks.result: PARTIAL — two non-security defects noted in hardening: (a) video uploads always 500 — upload_post_media passes processed=None for video and _put_object then indexes _IMAGE_CONTENT_TYPES['video/mp4'] -> KeyError (storage.py:323) before any store; (b) FeedPostWriteSerializer.validate requires caption for KIND_POLL and embed_url for KIND_EMBED even on partial PATCH, so unrelated edits 400. Security-wise OK: images go through validate_image_file+normalize_image, video claims content-type whitelist +120MB cap, embed provider server-derived from host whitelist, embed_url URLField+hostname whitelist blocks javascript:/data:, all owner querysets filter store=_my_store(), public reads require is_published + public_feed_store_or_404, comment delete scoped post__store+customer.

checks.invariant: Webhook endpoint must not be throttle-starved by shared provider egress IPs (availability of payment confirmation).
checks.result: UNRESOLVED (needs_validation). StoreMpWebhookView sets no throttle_classes -> defaults apply: ResilientAnonRateThrottle 'anon' 100/day + ResilientUserRateThrottle 'user' 1000/day, both keyed by REMOTE_ADDR|XFF-ident for anonymous requests. All MP webhook deliveries platform-wide arrive from MP's shared egress IPs; >100 signed deliveries/day from one IP -> 429 -> legitimate payment notifications dropped (MP retries, but sustained volume could delay order confirmation). Same exposure exists on the platform webhook. Whether MP's webhook IPs are few/shared and whether 429 responses trigger MP retries is a deployment/provider fact not source-visible.

candidates.title: Feed customer writes (comment/like/vote) are completely unthrottled — FeedWriteThrottle is an AnonRateThrottle that skips authenticated customers
candidates.description: All three customer write endpoints of the store feed — POST /api/stores/public/<slug>/feed/<pk>/comments/, .../like/, .../vote/ — declare FeedWriteThrottle (scope 'store_review', 10/hour, intended as antispam). FeedWriteThrottle extends ResilientAnonRateThrottle -> DRF AnonRateThrottle.get_cache_key returns None whenever request.user.is_authenticated is truthy. CustomerJWTAuthentication returns the Customer object as request.user and Customer.is_authenticated is a property returning True, so for every request that can possibly reach the handlers (all require IsCustomer) the throttle's cache key is None and allow_request returns True unconditionally. The throttle is dead code: a single registered customer account (self-service registration, is_active=True by default, no email verification needed for the customer_access JWT) can post unlimited 600-char comments on any published store feed, toggle likes, and cast poll votes without any rate limit. Sibling code proves intent: StoreReviewThrottle for product reviews explicitly overrides get_cache_key to bucket POSTs by 'review-customer-<pk>' because 'AnonRateThrottle saltaria la cuota a un comprador autenticado', and the support domain uses _CustomerScopedThrottle keyed 'c<pk>'. Amplifier: PublicFeedCommentsView.get returns every non-hidden comment of a post with no LIMIT/pagination, so once spam accumulates every public read of that post returns an unbounded payload. Poll integrity: votes are unique per (post, customer) but account creation is cheap, so multi-account vote/like inflation is feasible; comments need only ONE account.
candidates.root_cause: FeedWriteThrottle subclasses ResilientAnonRateThrottle (AnonRateThrottle) instead of a customer-scoped throttle; AnonRateThrottle.get_cache_key returns None for authenticated request.user, and CustomerJWTAuthentication sets request.user to a Customer whose is_authenticated is True — so the throttle never engages for the only principal allowed by IsCustomer.
candidates.intended_behavior: Customer feed writes should be rate-limited per account (like StoreReviewThrottle's 'review-customer-<pk>' bucket or support's 'c<pk>' bucket) at the configured 'store_review' 10/hour scope, and the public comments listing should be bounded.

trace.description: PublicFeedCommentsView mounted at stores/public/<slug>/feed/<pk>/comments/ (POST) plus like/vote routes lines 38-39.
class FeedWriteThrottle(ResilientAnonRateThrottle): scope='store_review' — inherits AnonRateThrottle.get_cache_key with NO customer-aware override.
CustomerJWTAuthentication.authenticate returns (customer, token) -> DRF sets request.user = Customer.
Customer.is_authenticated property returns True -> AnonRateThrottle.get_cache_key returns None.
AnonRateThrottle.get_cache_key: 'if request.user and request.user.is_authenticated: return None' -> SimpleRateThrottle.allow_request returns True.
FeedComment.objects.create(post=post, customer=request.customer, body=...) — no rate limit, no dedupe, no store-level quota.
comments = post.comments.filter(is_hidden=False).select_related('customer') returned in full — no [:N] cap, no pagination.
StoreReviewThrottle.get_cache_key explicitly buckets POST by customer.pk — the known-correct pattern the feed throttle fails to replicate.

candidates.evidence: Source-complete: throttle class hierarchy, DRF throttle implementation in venv, Customer.is_authenticated property, IsCustomer permission on all three write views, unbounded comments queryset, sibling throttle implementations in stores/support domains, and Customer.is_active default True with self-service /api/customer-auth/register/ (throttled 10/h/IP only).
candidates.conditions: Attacker holds any customer_access JWT (free self-registration; email verification not required for is_active). Target store has has_feed benefit and a published feed post. For like/vote count inflation, multiple customer accounts needed; for comment spam a single account suffices.

execution.command: venv/Scripts/python.exe manage.py test StoreApp.domains.feed  # (no feed test file exists — coverage gap); manual: register customer -> POST 20 comments to /api/stores/public/<slug>/feed/<pk>/comments/ -> all 201, no 429
execution.observed_result: Source-derived (read-only audit, no execution): FeedWriteThrottle.get_cache_key -> AnonRateThrottle.get_cache_key -> request.user.is_authenticated True -> None -> allow_request True for every authenticated request; IsCustomer blocks anonymous before throttle matters, so the throttle can never deny any request.

candidates.remediation: Replace FeedWriteThrottle with a customer-scoped throttle mirroring StoreReviewThrottle/_CustomerScopedThrottle: subclass SimpleRateThrottle (or reuse DaventProject.throttling._ResilientThrottleMixin) and key the cache by f'c{request.customer.pk}' (fallback IP for anonymous) with scope 'store_review'/'10/hour'. Additionally cap PublicFeedCommentsView.get (e.g. comments.filter(is_hidden=False).select_related('customer')[:200] or paginate) and consider a per-store inbound comment quota analogous to SUPPORT_STORE_MSGS_PER_HOUR.

severity.rationale: Trivially exploitable by any registered customer (no verification gate) but impact is abuse-class: unlimited public comment spam (owner-moderatable one-by-one), poll/like skew requiring multi-account registration, unbounded comment-list payloads amplifying read cost, and DB growth. No confidentiality or authorization boundary is crossed; no notifications/emails are triggered by comments/likes/votes.

hardening: Feed video upload is functionally broken (not security): upload_post_media video branch passes processed=None for kind='video' and storage._put_object then evaluates _IMAGE_CONTENT_TYPES[upload.content_type] -> KeyError on 'video/mp4' -> HTTP 500 on every video media upload (feed/services/feed.py:155-160 -> stores/services/storage.py:322-324).

FeedPostWriteSerializer.validate requires caption (KIND_POLL) / embed_url (KIND_EMBED) even on partial PATCH, so unrelated edits like toggling is_published on a poll/embed post return 400 (feed/serializers/serializers.py:36-65).
StoreFeedCommentsView.get filters comments by raw ?post= query param without int validation -> non-numeric value raises Django ValidationError/ValueError -> 500 (feed/views/views.py:163-165).
PublicFeedCommentsView.get returns all non-hidden comments unpaginated — bound it regardless of the throttle fix (feed/views/views.py:211-215).

StoreMpWebhookView relies on default throttles (anon 100/day + user 1000/day keyed by IP); MP webhook egress IPs are shared platform-wide — consider throttle_classes=[] or a dedicated scope so legitimate payment notifications cannot be 429'd at volume (storepayments/views/webhook.py:109-114).

Order payment proofs use object_url(key, private=True) with the 7-day default presigned TTL while chat attachments use an explicit 1h TTL — consider passing expires=3600 for consistency on buyer PII receipts (orders/serializers/serializers.py:170, orders/views/public.py:279; orders domain, adjacent).
uncovered: StoreMpWebhookView default-throttle exposure to shared MP egress IPs — needs deployment/provider validation (see unresolved).
AdminApp/domains/chat attachment signed-URL pattern was spot-checked only via grep (object_url private=True, expires=3600 confirmed); full chat attachment ACL review belongs to the chat domain unit.
StoreApp/domains/orders full order/payment isolation review belongs to the orders unit; only the bridging functions consumed by storepayments/support were verified.
